Says Australians need: Atto Notorio (sworn declaration, obtainable at an Italian Consulate in Australia with four adult witnesses, or arranged in Italy); Nulla Osta signed in person at the Australian Embassy Rome or Consulate-General Milan, then legalised at the Prefettura with a marca da bollo; passports, full birth certificates with NAATI Italian translations and DFAT apostilles, divorce/death certificates; 300-day rule for divorced women. Ceremony options: civil (comune or approved venue, interpreter required if not fluent), religious, symbolic after legal marriage in Australia.
